name: Sarvagya Jain
title: Data Analyst | Python Developer | AI Enthusiast
about: Hi, I'm Sarvag Jain, a Computer Science Engineering student and aspiring Data Analyst with a passion for transforming raw data into meaningful business insights. I enjoy working with Python, SQL, PostgreSQL, Power BI, and Excel to clean, analyze, and visualize data. Through hands-on projects, I've gained experience in exploratory data analysis (EDA), database management, SQL querying, and interactive dashboard development. I'm always eager to learn new technologies and build data-driven solutions that help businesses make smarter decisions.
